summarize_haiku_module_with_tabulate: use hk.experimental.tabulate to produce a table summarising module params, inputs, and outputs
trace_method_calls_with_eval_summary: use hk.experimental.eval_summary to record MethodInvocation objects for each Haiku module method call
create_array_spec_from_jax_array: use ArraySpec.from_array to extract shape and dtype from a JAX array
inspect_module_details_via_module_detail: use ModuleDetails.of to capture a Haiku module params and state as ArraySpec dicts
filter_tabulate_output_by_columns: pass custom columns and filters to hk.experimental.tabulate to control which module info is displayed
